gizmo.title: Ithayile yenani
gizmo.description: Inani elinye elibalulekileyo, nelebhile yalo nendlela elitshintshe ngayo. Beka ezininzi kwigridi ukwenza umqolo wedeshibhodi.

configure.title: Ixabiso
configure.description: Inani. Inani eliqhelekileyo liqokelelwa ngokolwimi lwephepha; nantoni na enye iboniswa njengoko ibhaliwe.

configure.title: Utshintsho
configure.description: Indlela elitshintshe ngayo, ngamagama, njenge-6% kule kota.
